facts.business: Alivus Life Sciences Limited is a professionally managed company engaged in the development and manufacturing of high-value, non-commoditised Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs) across chronic therapeutic segments such as Cardiovascular, CNS, Pain Management, Oncology, Diabetes, and Urology, and also operates in the API CDMO space.
facts.related_party_note: Contribution of Rs 6.00 million to Nirma Education and Research Foundation in relation to CSR expenditure.
